* Automatically detects the MIME type of a document based on magic * markers in the stream prefix and any given metadata hints. *

* The given stream is expected to support marks, so that this method * can reset the stream to the position it was in before this method * was called. * * @param input document stream, or null * @param metadata metadata hints * @return MIME type of the document * @throws IOException if the document stream could not be read
